info.title: Showpass Organizer Access Passwords API
info.description: List, retrieve, create and update event and ticket type access codes, and remove their bindings.

get.description: The developer key must belong to this organization and its employee must retain Manage Events or All Access. The password field contains the configured access code or regex pattern. Treat it as a secret. Includes active and inactive records. Developer-key requests always return a page. Use ordering=id for a consistent order across page requests.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Use id or -id to order by password ID.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page requests are independent and may reflect intervening edits.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Page requests are independent and may reflect intervening edits.

parameters.name: venue_id
parameters.description: Organization ID bound to the key.

post.description: The developer key must belong to this organization and its employee must retain Manage Events or All Access. The password field contains the configured access code or regex pattern. Treat it as a secret. Creates the configuration synchronously. Use event_id for an event binding or ticket_type for a direct ticket type binding. With event_id, use ticket_type_ids to specify which ticket types the code reveals. Use start_time and end_time to schedule access. is_regex_match enables case-insensitive regex matching. Check for a saved record before retrying.

put.description: The developer key must belong to this organization and its employee must retain Manage Events or All Access. The password field contains the configured access code or regex pattern. Treat it as a secret. Updates the stored configuration synchronously. Use event_id for an event binding or ticket_type for a direct ticket type binding. With event_id, use ticket_type_ids to specify which ticket types the code reveals. Use start_time and end_time to schedule access. is_regex_match enables case-insensitive regex matching. An omitted password keeps its current value.

delete.description: The developer key must belong to this organization and its employee must retain Manage Events or All Access. Removes one event binding or deactivates the direct ticket type binding. The password record can still be retrieved afterward. Check the binding before retrying; a repeat removal can return 400.
